turbo.title: Turbo Certification
turbo.description: Turbo is a certification launched by openFuyao, specifically designed to identify cloud-native applications that have been accelerated. Applications with Turbo certification have undergone rigorous performance optimization and quality assurance, providing more efficient and stable service experiences.
turbo.step1: Apply: Developers or ecosystem partners submit an application for certification.
turbo.step2: Evaluate: The Application Enablement SIG group conducts performance evaluation and quality testing on the application.
turbo.step3: Certify: Applications that pass the evaluation and meet the standards will receive the Turbo certification badge.
